# Commands reliability hardening: Pull hooks, maintenance cancellation, and Amend recovery

Eight maintenance-stop cases passed after correcting the expected SQLite matcher from `/closed/i` to `/database is not open/i`; existing knowledge/repository/publication/history/sync contracts passed 49/49. Verified cases include descendant closure, interrupted merge cleanup, database close ordering, and completed-record receipt preservation. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
